```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## SET THE PARAMETERS IN THE R FILES continuous_simulation.R or discrete_simulation.R
continuous <- TRUE ## CHANGE THIS TO FALSE FOR THE DISCRETE SIMULATION
generate_markdown <- TRUE
if(continuous){
  source("continuous_simulation.R")
} else {
  source("discrete_simulation.R")
}
```

## Simulation Parameters

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
pars_df <- readRDS("/results/last_sim_pars.RDS")
knitr::kable(pars_df, caption = "Simulation parameter values", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Simulation Results
```{r, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
res_df <- readRDS("/results/last_sim_results.RDS")
knitr::kable(res_df, caption = "Simulation results", row.names = FALSE)
```
